title: wait-until

setup.note: "bookings open 10 am tomorrow" said on Sat 2026-08-29 09:00 IST. The step is a wait-until: it starts at 09:55 IST (2026-08-30T04:25Z — the poll lead the policy allows, never earlier), polls, and stops (11:00 IST, or 20 polls, or the task leaving 'scheduled').

steps: report the moment tickets are live

schedules.reason: start 5 min before the 10:00 IST window, poll every 3 min, stop at 11:00 IST or 20 polls
